text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
――...Mm, track conditions and weather
are both just as simulated.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(Now I'll check the detailed numbers over there
and feed the strategy into 'Parcae'—)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
> Do you start to initialize ?
> [y]:

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(The reconstructed 'Parcae' remains unchanged,
continuing to spit out the correct answers.
Nothing has changed. Except...)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...Now that's what I call occult.
"I stopped feeling anything"... give me a break.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(This is ridiculous. It's just a program.
It's ridiculous, but...)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(Some part of me strangely accepts that
showing me that worst-case fate once more back then...
was just to fire me up.)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"...Guess I'll go.
—I gotta reboot myself, too."

text_block_list.name: Newspaper Headline
text_block_list.text:
"A star-studded lineup gathers!
Who will conquer the Spring Tenno Sho—the model student's counterattack,
an upset victory, or will it be the Opera O after all!"

text_block_list.name: Online Article
text_block_list.text:
"Tenno Sho (Spring) Special Feature!
Summit Dialogue—The Rivals' True Feelings"

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
Man, the Spring Tenno Sho is really hyped up as always!
Come to think of it, that was today, wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text:
"Come to think of it, they were talking on TV the other day about that...
gloomy girl... Air Shakur, was it?
She's running too, right?"

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text:
Getting told off that much is pretty rough.
Can she really hold her own in that lineup, I wonder?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Did you say something?
Can't hear ya!

text_block_list.name: Passersby A & B
text_block_list.text:
Hyek...!
It's nothing...!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: If it's nothing, then don't run away.
choice_data_list: Looks like you're doing fine now.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah.
I've got plenty of room to spare, I told ya.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I mean, what the hell are you basing that on?
Don't just nod seeing them get intimidated.
choice_data_list: Since we're out here, you gotta want to soak in the cheers, right?
Since we're out here, it'd be great to soak in the cheers, wouldn't it?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: You think so?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: However... I still don't get how the hell that works either.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Even if they hate me,
if I'm the strongest, I'll be the number one favorite.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Naturally, there are times when that happens.
However, at its core, it is fundamentally different.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"Haaah!?
Stop saying such creepy crap!"

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: I was just thinking about the logic behind why that is.
choice_data_list: Everyone has their own story, you know.
Everyone has their own story, after all.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: A drama...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: —Come to think of it... rivals who clash their dreams and pride against each other, was it?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Something some piece of shit hater said before.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: I don't have anyone like that, so I can't even tell if it's the "real deal" or not.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"You just got lucky," huh...?
Seriously, shut the hell up.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Still, I'm done letting them run their mouths.
Time to put an end to it... Right?
choice_data_list: So we can win, can't we?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Hah. 
Way to hype yourself up.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I won't make empty promises.
But... I'm done spewing curses, too.

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Ah, they're coming out!
Eeeeeeek~~!!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Before the dazzling greenery of summer comes the lovely tail end of spring...
In other words, I have arrived!
Now, feast your eyes in magnificent glory!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Let's see, does this need a blowing kiss too!
There, there~âª

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Come on, Doto, you too!
Let's liven things up big time!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Eeeek...!
U-Um, well...!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: W-Well, obviously~...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Uwoooooah...!)

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Hyek!?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Fufu.
I can't let myself lose either!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Everyone!
Thank you so much for cheering me on!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Yes, those voices... they become my strength. I'll answer them with thrilling races alongside wonderful rivals!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: —I'm looking forward to facing you in a fair and square match, too!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
It's not like I'm
looking forward to it or anything.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Huh...? Air Shakur really is cool... or maybe just totally blunt.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Kind of a buzzkill...
It'd be way more fun if she just went totally wild.
Wasn't that her whole thing anyway?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: (Lucky? Who the hell could look at this situation and say that?)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ("Same generation," "rivals"... Stop forcing that on me. It's got nothin' to do with me.)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: (I ain't runnin' just to be looked at. I'm runnin' to elevate myself.)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: —That's my pride on the line.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(I don't need anyone's expectations.
Once it's over, you'll see what being 'the real deal' means—)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
From today onward,
I'm climbing to the top...!
